text: {"sql":"SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.created_at <= '2026-07-31' THEN oi.amount ELSE 0 END) AS july_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN o.created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.created_at <= '2026-08-31' THEN oi.amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01'","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
